layers.name: Content Management APIs
layers.description: Coordinates provider configuration, prompts, memory, costs, images, generation, assets, imports, and HTTP request handling.

layers.name: Project Automation Configuration
layers.description: Defines repository guidance, dependency updates, continuous integration, container builds, and documentation workflows.

layers.name: World Domain Logic
layers.description: Implements world, character, entity, illustration, canonical-fact, campaign-transfer, and runtime lifecycle behavior.

layers.name: Shared Data Contracts
layers.description: Defines shared TypeScript schemas and types for worlds, stories, generation, imports, prompts, memory, users, assets, and transfers.

layers.name: Core Platform Runtime
layers.description: Provides database access and migrations, security controls, logging, story-engine behavior, provider integrations, and shared runtime infrastructure.

layers.name: Nexus Documentation
layers.description: Contains the VitePress documentation site, architecture records, conceptual guides, installation content, and documentation tooling configuration.

layers.name: Integration Test Suite
layers.description: Contains database helpers, Compose test configuration, and integration tests covering admission control, campaigns, imports, gameplay, generation, dashboards, and image workflows.
